application.description: E-commerce channel: Shopify Admin GraphQL API 2026-07 — products, inventory, orders, fulfillment, returns and every other Admin query/mutation, plus all webhook topics. Tier-1 canonical services share one contract with amazon_sp_api and flipkart_seller (docs/ecommerce/ioflow_canonical_channel_contract.md). Token in X-Shopify-Access-Token via the per-shop client_credentials grant (own/dev stores) or a refresh token. The older 'shopify' seed is REST 2024-01 and unrelated.

shop_domain.label: Shop domain
shop_domain.description: your-store.myshopify.com — a Dev-Dashboard development store for sandbox, the live store for production.

client_id.label: Client ID
client_id.description: Dev Dashboard app client ID (app in the same organisation as the store for client_credentials).

client_secret.label: Client secret
client_secret.description: Dev Dashboard app client secret — also the webhook HMAC key.

refresh_token.label: Refresh token
refresh_token.description: Only for authorization-code (expiring offline token) installs.

location_id.label: Default location
location_id.description: Location GID used for stock when channel_location_id is blank.

services.description: CANONICAL tier-1 service (identical parameters/output on amazon_sp_api, flipkart_seller, shopify_admin; contract: docs/ecommerce/ioflow_canonical_channel_contract.md). Shopify Admin GraphQL: No channel_product_id: productSet (synchronous) creating a single-variant product — sku, price, compareAtPrice=mrp, barcode, inventoryItem {tracked, harmonizedSystemCode=hsn_code, weight}, available quantity at channel_location_id (or the connection's location_id), images as files. With channel_product_id: productUpdate (+ productVariantsBulkUpdate when channel_variant_id is given) — never productSet, which would drop other variants. status INACTIVE -> DRAFT. Publishing to a specific sales channel (Online Store) is tier-2 publishable_publish. Scopes: write_products (+ write_inventory for quantities). HS codes shorter than 6 digits are rejected by Shopify.
